title: DinoV3-LSTM for Early-Stage Classification of Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation in ECGs Toward Prediction

contributions.purpose: 用视觉基础模型做 PAF 前兆/指示分类
contributions.mechanism: 将 DinoV3(蒸馏视觉 FM)适配到多通道 2D ECG 编码(STFT/GAF/PMAT)并接 LSTM 时序头,无 ECG 专门微调
contributions.evaluation: 公开长程 ECG 数据集,冻结图像预训练权重
contributions.source_quote: We present a streamlined framework that adapts a distillation-based vision foundation model, DinoV3, to multi-channel two-dimensional ECG encodings and combines it with an LSTM to form an indicator model for precursor classification.

contributions.mechanism: 与经典 ECG 分类器及 SSL 基线比较
contributions.source_quote: the DinoV3-based indicator model achieves competitive results across all metrics... even without the ECG dataset fine tuning

self_declared_provenance.quote: We adapt DinoV3 to process 2D ECG patch representations (PMAT, STFT, GAF)
To enhance representation learning, we replace the [MAE encoder with the DinoV3 feature extractor]

notes: 重复投稿红旗:PDF 与 AS0288(forum 3Y2ZEQiZFx)字节完全相同(MD5 85b3c2673d67adc4c83d8efbc01c3c7d),同一篇被投两次,两次均 reject。夸大声明:称"competitive across all metrics (Acc,Spe,Sen,MCC,F1)",但表 1 显示 DinoV3 在 F1(0.5489)、Sen(0.5368)被 Trs 基线(0.6208/0.6416)反超,且 MCC 列在表中根本没出现。作者诚实限定范围(只做指示分类不做预测)、无前瞻验证。整体绝对性能都偏低(Acc≈0.60)。
